title: Stability of Lagrangian Generalized Nash Equilibriums
summary: Lagrangian generalized Nash equilibriums (LGNEs) were introduced by Rockafellar (2024) for a class of generalized Nash equilibrium problems (GNEPs) in which each player's strategy is subject to conic constraints. This paper investigates the stability properties of the LGNE solution set, specifically focusing on the Aubin property, isolated calmness, and Lipschitz continuous single-valued localization.
